metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.5 · 1999 · Pettson & Findus - Katten och gubbens år
metas.description: Pettson and Findus remember their adventures while waiting for the storm to pass.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.3 · 2000 · Pettson & Findus - Kattonauten
metas.description: The cat Findus decides he wants to write a letter to the King, because Pettson says that kittens don't wash or pay rent. While Findus waits for a response, he and the old man decide to go on a trip.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.4 · 2005 · Pettson & Findus: The Santa Machine
metas.description: The old man PETTSON and his cat FINDUS live on a small farm way out in the countryside in Sweden. Christmas is approaching, and Pettson has given Findus the rash promise that THE TOMTE will come around with gifts for him at Christ...

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.0 · 2009 · Pettson & Findus IV: Forget-Abilities
metas.description: A trip to the lake inspires Pettersson to invent a machine that does not work as expected. Findus asks a shooting star for a wish, and that again does not turn out to be the best idea.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.4 · 2014 · Pettson and Findus: A Little Nuisance, a Great Friendship
metas.description: The adventures of a grumpy old farmer and his cat.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 5.5 · 2016 · Pettersson und Findus 2 - Das schönste Weihnachten überhaupt
metas.description: Pettson promised Findus they would have the best christmas ever this year, but then everything goes wrong. Findus is afraid that Christmas is going to be cancelled at all. So he tries to get help on his own.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 4.9 · 2018 · Pettson and Findus: Findus Moves House
metas.description: The old man Petterson is trying to sleep but his cat Findus is keeping him awake, so they both agree that Findus shall have his own house. Based on the beloved books by Sven Nordqvist.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 4.0 · 2022 · Die Mucklas ... und wie sie zu Pettersson und Findus kamen
